fieldNotes.truckGate: Property fully enclosed in chain-link fencing with privacy-screened sliding gates across the truck-yard drives — confirmed in 2018 and 2025 Street View (sv-gate, sv-79th-e). At least two gated vehicle entrances along the south/southwest perimeter.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth structure at any gate in any Street View heading probed.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gates present, no guard shack -> remote / manual check-in.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Two gated entrances on the perimeter (SW and a second along the south) — modeled as separate in/out gates.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Open paved/gravel yard inside the fence on the south and southeast functions as a holding/staging area before the docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The west dock apron and the SE yard give ample depth for a 3+ truck queue inside the fence.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Large open paved/gravel yard area to the southeast leaves significant unused width to add a bypass / express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Extensive canopied dock bays along the building's west face plus additional doors on the south face — banded 25-50; count is an estimate from overhead imagery of the dock canopies.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs immediately along the building's east edge, but no dedicated spur is clearly visible breaking into the Pactiv property — classified false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: West dock apron plus the SE open yard could hold ~30 trailers; estimate.
